title: 1% to 100%: the recharge before-and-after
summary: Show yourself, your pet or your space at 1% battery, then fully charged at 100%. AI makes the battery overlays and the "after" shot.
why: Later's Instagram Reels trends roundup, updated October 30, 2026, lists "Recharged" as a new trend that week: a before-and-after Reel that goes from 1% to 100%, opening on a low-battery hook.
steps: Pick your before-and-after. It can be you before and after coffee, your dog before and after a walk, a messy desk before and after a tidy, or a shop before and after opening.
Take the real "before" photo or clip. Then use the main prompt to add a low-battery icon, or film the real "after" and add a full-battery icon to it.
Put the two shots back to back in a Reel or TikTok. Show the 1% shot for a second, then cut to 100% on a beat.
Add a short hook on screen, like "Down to 1%. Watch this." Keep the caption short.

prompts.label: Main prompt: add the battery overlay
prompts.text: Here are two photos of me. Photo 1 is my "before": tired, slumped, low energy. Photo 2 is my "after": awake and ready to go. Don't change my face, body or the room. Add a large, simple phone-style battery icon in the top corner of each photo. On photo 1, the battery is almost empty, with a thin red sliver and "1%" next to it. On photo 2, the battery is full and green with "100%" next to it. Use a clean, flat icon with no phone brand or logo. Keep everything else exactly as it is.

prompts.label: Variation: make the 100% shot
prompts.text: This photo shows me at the end of a long day, looking drained, with a small red battery icon reading "1%" in the top corner. Make a matching "100%" version: same person, same face, same outfit, same room and camera angle, but now I'm sitting up straight, smiling, with a hot drink in my hand and warm morning light through the window. Change the battery icon to full and green, reading "100%". Keep it looking like a real photo.

prompts.label: Variation: pet edition
prompts.text: Here is a photo of my [dog or cat] flopped out asleep. Add a simple flat battery icon above its head, nearly empty and red, labelled "1%". Then make a second image of the same pet, same markings and same room, now wide awake and mid-zoomie with its ears up, with a full green battery icon labelled "100%". Realistic photo style, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run a [type of business, like a café, salon or repair shop]. Here are two real photos of our space: one before we open, dark and empty, and one during the day, open and busy. Don't change the space or add customers who aren't there. Add a simple flat battery icon in the top corner of each: red and "1%" on the before photo, green and "100%" on the open photo. Leave any signs as they are and don't add prices, sale banners or extra text.

tips: Use your own real before-and-after where you can. AI is best used for the battery icons, not for faking results.
Shoot both photos from the same spot and angle. The cut feels much more satisfying when only the energy changes.
If the AI changes your face, upload the original again and say "keep my face exactly the same, only add the icon".
Business accounts should pick a sound from the app's commercial library so the Reel isn't muted.
